description:
Read the account's auto top-up configuration: whether it is on, the balance threshold that triggers it, the amount added, whether a payment method is actually on file, and `effectiveAmount` — what `top_up_account_credit` would charge right now. If `paymentMethodOnFile` is false the settings are inert: nothing can be charged and auto top-up will never fire, and a card can only be saved on porkbun.com, never through the API.

`cards` lists the saved cards (up to 3), primary first then backups: a top-up charges the primary and falls back to the backups in that order. Each has `status` (`active`, `expired`, or `declined` with `retryAfter`) and `lastDeclineCode`; a Link wallet shows `usedForTopups: false`. Use it to tell the user which card would be charged, or that a card needs attention. Cards are added, removed and reordered only on porkbun.com.
name: get_auto_topup
title: Get Auto Topup
